limits.admittedSurface: ruled only: linear with two control rows and positive (possibly unequal) endpoint weights in one direction, any positive-weight rational multi-span in the other; non-periodic in the ruling direction

limitations: Only ruled surfaces are admitted; general tensor NURBS surfaces report explicit unsupported_surface regions (general CS remains open)
Tangency and multiple-root regions are unresolved by design: crossings whose unit-column determinant |det(C',S_u,S_v)| <= 1e-6 are never reported as points

Curve-on-surface overlaps are admitted only for the two algebraically exact families (a collinear span on a ruling with a Mobius-lifted V range, or an iso-V proportional homogeneous blend after degree elevation, cap 25); general on-surface curves stay explicit unresolved bands. Overlaps carry UV path endpoints only: no per-parameter correspondence is claimed (unequal-weight rulings induce a Mobius correspondence along V)

Partial ruling trims (curve span extending past the surface V range) report explicit coincident_trim regions instead of clipped intervals; coincidence candidate finding absorbs only halo bands touching certified roots, and ambiguous bands stay near_coincidence
Geometrically closed ruled surfaces (coincident U domain ends, e.g. a full cylinder seam) can report seam-duplicate boundary contacts at u=0 and u=1 plus halo bands; seam unification is out of scope

V never subdivides (a ruling is one knot span): terminal boxes refine V only through Newton from the span midpoint, and boxes whose Newton image leaves the box stay silent exactly as in the curve/curve query

Queries don't prove Boolean completion: NumericallyResolved is not certified complete-domain coverage, and permitsTopologyChange stays false; CS against arbitrary NURBS surfaces, analytic SS pairs and certified tangency remain open
